India's Election Commission Systems Under Scrutiny Over Voter Rolls

India's Election Commission's voter software systems, ECINet and ERONET, are under scrutiny following reports of a rift concerning voter rolls. The systems are central to the current row, with discussions focusing on their functionality and alleged centralization.
